attributes.description: Inventory of Google Workspace user accounts: admins, 2-Step Verification, suspension and lifecycle state.

params.markdown:
The Users dashboard shows the **inventory** of Google Workspace user accounts collected by the `users` data stream: one document per user per collection cycle. It describes what exists, not what happened; account activity is in the User Account and Admin dashboards.

Users are collected once per interval (24 hours by default), so the dashboard opens on the last 24 hours. Counts are unique users.

The **Admin roles** panel shows named roles, and **Top groups** shows data, only when the optional admin roles and group membership settings are enabled.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/google_workspace/)**

query.query: not google_workspace.users.suspended : true and (user.entity.lifecycle.last_activity < "now-90d" or not user.entity.lifecycle.last_activity : *)

embeddableConfig.title: Active accounts with no sign-in in 90 days
